profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | building AI agents for engineering operations and enterprise software delivery
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I’m a Staff Software Engineer with deep experience building enterprise ad tech systems and a growing focus on AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, and engineering automation.
My background is in high-complexity backend systems: trafficking, billing, ad server integrations, delivery data, operational tooling, and legacy modernization. I’ve spent years working in the messy middle of real production software, where the hard part is rarely just writing code. It is understanding the business rules, the data model, the failure modes, the deployment path, and the human workflow around the system.
Recently, my work has shifted heavily toward AI developer tools and multi-agent systems. I’ve been building an internal agent platform that coordinates specialized agents for engineering operations: code implementation, PR review, Jira sync, release summaries, worktree management, documentation, QA, time logging, and operational memory. The goal is not novelty. The goal is to make engineering teams faster, clearer, and less buried in repetitive coordination work.

I’m especially interested in:
- AI agents that can safely operate inside real engineering systems
- Developer tools that preserve context across long-running work
- LLM-assisted code review, planning, debugging, and release workflows
- Human-in-the-loop automation for teams with real compliance and production constraints
- Turning expert engineering judgment into repeatable agent behavior

I’m strongest where product complexity, engineering depth, and workflow design meet. I like building tools that make other engineers more capable.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Build and maintain backend systems for advertising workflows across trafficking, billing, ad server integrations, targeting, and delivery operations.

Lead implementation for complex ad tech features involving Google Ads, DFP/Google Ad Manager, Adswizz, internal targeting services, billing setup, campaign creation, and operational data flows.

Modernize legacy systems while preserving production behavior, business rules, and compliance-sensitive release processes.

Design internal AI-assisted engineering workflows using multi-agent systems, persistent memory, Jira/Bitbucket/Confluence integrations, and automated worktree orchestration.

Created agent workflows for code implementation, PR review, release coordination, ticket synchronization, team digests, documentation maintenance, QA, and engineering operations.

Translate ambiguous business and operational requirements into maintainable systems, tests, rollout plans, and team-readable implementation paths.

Mentor through code review, architecture feedback, debugging support, and practical engineering judgment across backend and cross-functional work.
positions.insights: Agentic AI Development, AI Agents and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Web Apps:
Designed UX/UI and developed full stack web applications used internally.  Applications were developed using backends such as Python, Django, and Postgres, and Front end languages such as HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, javascript, and jQuery.

Designed and developed web application called Vendor DB based on internal need to track information about the 100's of applications used by Pandora Employees.  It tracked important admin notes, how it was used, main contacts, contracts, sox compliance, etc.  Notification system to help remind procurement groups of expiring contracts, and remind business to review info to make sure it was up to date. 

Developed internal Office Maps utility. Integrated with the staff directory and generated searchable office maps to search and find employees, rooms, and printers at each corporate office.

Enterprise Integrations: 
Responsible for delivering enterprise integration solutions and services using Enterprise Integration Technologies like Mulesoft Anypoint Studio ESB, Java, ActiveMQ, Django, and REST/SOAP api's.
ETL of business data sources from and into our Hadoop/Hive warehouse.
Providing technical expertise and leadership to develop integration architecture solutions spanning business processes, systems, hardware, operating systems, apps and networking environments and platforms
Reviewing or designing complex enterprise integration architectures for business stakeholders, making recommendations, implementing the designs either onsite or through remote services.
Strategic proof of concepts using open source and/or commercial products.

My team helped with migrating to Workday HCM and built out mule integrations and workday studio integrations to send data to and from benefits providers.  Developed integrations between workday and Pandora's internal directory for automation of employee new hire, updates, and termination processes.

Helped refactor and upgrade integrations Mule ESB v3.4 Community Edition, to v3.9 Enterprise Edition.

positions.title: Geek Squad
positions.description:
Promoted from computer sales through various associate jobs to current highest level of Double Agent.

Performed invaluable services to several local businesses to recover important data for continued operation.

Respond to emergency calls for technical services on a 24/7 available basis.

Received Best Buy All Star award in 2008 for going beyond normal call of duty.

Considered "go-to" guy for both in-store and outside advanced service calls.
